interpretation_limits: Skill requirements are acceptance criteria, never evidence that a trial met them.
All upstream outcomes are report claims, not our independent video evaluation or physical reproduction.
Human setup, in-run assistance, supervision, target changes and cleanup outcomes stay separate.
18 task/variant coverage, including 9 with conditional successful cases, is not a pooled success rate.
Command processing and command waiting are not pure motor and model inference times; unrecorded latency remains unknown.
No coordinates, calibration, privileged simulation state or traditional visual localization are imported into execution.
Local tests audit contract structure and synthetic evidence; they do not authenticate image pixels or independent reviewers.
transfer_priorities: Freeze goal variant and task roles before a run; record a new version when the user changes either.
Use relative object effects and support transitions as progress, not arm arrival or motion commands.
Separate task milestone, release/stability, controlled return and post-run hardware status.
Change observation or contact strategy after bounded no-progress; never reset failure debt with observer motion or process restart.
Treat uncertain/partial sends, timeout and lost hold as execution issues; visual retry suggestions cannot clear them.
Treat extended tools, grasped objects, camera brackets and cables as relevant to corridor review.

semantic_findings.detail: Reviewed ambiguity was fixed in this round: builtin blackboard-wiping now accepts contact sliding only. Erasure is a distinct frozen recipe with erasure_criterion_satisfied; missing effect evidence cannot advance.
semantic_findings.remaining_limitation: Actual erasure/contact pixel judgment and provenance authentication remain outside this offline ledger.

semantic_findings.detail: extract_segment peer_stable is ambiguous for cabinet/fixture/stack; use existing task-specific object stability claims and never infer observer physical support.
